label: TP
reason: User input from request.getParameter() flows through a Base64 encode/decode round-trip which preserves the original content (including XSS payloads like <script>). The resulting 'bar' string is then written directly to the HTTP response via printf() without any HTML entity encoding or sanitization. Additionally, X-XSS-Protection header is disabled, removing browser-side defenses.

evidence.note: User-supplied parameter retrieved from request without initial validation.
Base64 encode/decode round-trip applied to param; this transformation does not remove XSS characters (<, >, &, ").
Processed bar variable passed to printf() sink without HTML escaping.
X-XSS-Protection header explicitly set to 0, disabling browser XSS filter.
